notes: SF-Fed Daily News Sentiment Index (Shapiro-Sudhof-Wilson). No key.
caveats: US-news-centric (EN-language) — not a good referent for the RU cohort. Revised in place by FRBSF on each publish, so a re-pull will change the sha256. Full history from 1980 but only the 2024-02+ window is used in analysis.
